question: How many open claims does each California adjuster have?

report.interpretation: Count of claims with status 'open' as of the 2026-09-30 extract, grouped by the adjuster currently responsible. Only adjusters in the California region are included. All seven are still employed.
report.answer: The 7 California adjusters hold 79 open claims between them. Mariah Berger has 13. Victoria Hampton and Timothy Castro have 12 each. Becky Crane and Alyssa Patel have 11 each. Emma Moss and Cody Adkins have 10 each. The workload is fairly even, with a range of 10 to 13.
report.answer_sql: select a.adjuster_id, a.full_name, count(c.claim_id) open_claims from adjusters a left join claims c on c.adjuster_id=a.adjuster_id and c.status='open' where a.region='California' group by all order by open_claims desc, a.adjuster_id
